title: LLM Evaluation in Python: Build an Eval Harness From Scratch
description: Build an LLM evaluation harness in Python that scores model outputs with code-based checks and an LLM judge you calibrate against human labels.
summary: You change the system prompt behind an LLM feature, try a few examples, and think you’ve fixed the bug. The new outputs look better when you inspect them manually, so you deploy the change.
takeaways: You’ll receive a score upon completion to help you track your learning progress: Interactive Quiz LLM Evaluation in Python: Build an Eval Harness From Scratch Test your understanding of LLM evaluation in Python, from rubrics and code checks to LLM judges, calibration, and release gates.
By the end of this tutorial, you’ll understand that: LLM evaluation tests model outputs against explicit criteria , so you can tell whether a prompt or model change made things better or worse.
The output compares two prompt versions across six evaluation dimensions, separates new failures from ones that already existed, and ends with a clear release decision.
